title: Um...
description: This adds random stuff to Minecraft. This is my first mod, so feel free to judge!
body: This mod adds some new items and weapons, and some new food. The main theme is bananas, but there are some other things too. This is my first mod, so it won't be amazing. I will fix the bugs (cause there are definitely some). There is also a new biome, some new items, and armor. Shout-out to Cloudratics for coming up with some of the weapons (go sub to his channel). There is also a new biome, again themed bananas. There are 3 dimensions. You can see what they are for yourself because i hate typing
